description: This file defines a generic decorator class for caching catalog lookup data in local storage within a Blazor web application. It implements caching logic to retrieve data from local storage if available and valid; otherwise, it fetches from the underlying service and caches the result.

classes.name: CachedCatalogLookupDataServiceDecorator`2
classes.description: A decorator that adds caching capabilities to catalog lookup data services, using local storage to cache results and reduce data fetches.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Retrieves the list of lookup data, utilizing local storage cache if valid; otherwise fetches fresh data and caches it.
